# example-role

The fixture's stand-in for the seven real `.claude/roles/*.md` charters. It carries no
front matter of its own, which is what the real seven look like too, so NT-0019 §4 step 5's
Reference stamp lands here by prepending — and `owner: maintainer` is §1.6's
`Reference — charters` row, read from the cell.

Cites `NT-0001` so the citation rewrite reaches this file like any other.
